$doc: The MEASURED census of every production file in the hugmesh org that names the
`hug.session` localStorage key — the fleet mirror this remote writes
not-yet-migrated remotes load their whole session from. tools/fleet-mirror/census.mjs
checks it in both directions (hugmesh-login-ui #18): a production file it does
not list is a NEW READER and fails; a listed file that stops matching is
MIGRATED and should be pruned; while any entry with a BLOCKING role remains
(reader, reader+hydrates) the write in session.service.ts may not be deleted.
`line` and `note` are evidence at the SHA the census was taken, not contract:
the guard matches on repo+file (or repo+prefix) only.
repos = every repository in the org (not just UIs: a BFF could ship a static
page). ignoredRepos are org repos deliberately not scanned, with the reason.
canary = the one file that MUST match. A census that matches nothing is
indistinguishable from a fleet that finished migrating (every entry reports
MIGRATED, exit 0) — measured: one typo in `key` produced exactly that green.
If the canary does not match, the SCAN is broken and the run is exit 2.
